chunks: We made (Moses) refuse a wet nurse before, so she said: 'Shall I direct you to a household that will bring him up for you and be sincere to him?'

key_terms.يَكْفُلُونَهُ: they will bring him up/take care of him

ai.seo_question: Who did Moses' sister suggest as a wet nurse for him?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the divine wisdom (Hikmah) behind Moses' (AS) rejection of other wet nurses, which facilitated the miraculous return of his mother to his care. In Shia exegesis, this event is often viewed as a precursor to the concept of 'Kafalah' (guardianship) and underscores the preservation of the Prophet's lineage and identity within his own family unit under God's direct supervision.
